metaTitle: Ovulation Calculator – Fertile Window & Period Tracker (Browser Only)
metaDescription: Free ovulation and period calculator. Find your fertile window, ovulation date, and next period for up to 6 cycles. 100% private — runs in your browser, no data stored.

faqs.question: How is the fertile window calculated?
faqs.answer: Ovulation typically occurs 14 days before the next period. The fertile window is the 5 days before ovulation plus ovulation day itself.

faqs.question: Is this data stored anywhere?
faqs.answer: No. All calculations are done in JavaScript in your browser. Nothing is sent to a server or shared with any third party.
